plain: We're starting this business together as equal partners.
legal: The Partners hereby establish the Business as equal partners.

plain: Each partner puts in $20,000 to start.
legal: Each Partner shall contribute initial capital of $20,000.

plain: Profits and losses are shared equally.
legal: Profits and losses shall be shared equally between the Partners.

plain: Big decisions need both partners to agree.
legal: Major decisions shall require the unanimous consent of the Partners.

plain: Either partner can sign checks up to $2,000.
legal: Either Partner may sign checks for amounts not exceeding $2,000.

plain: Anything above $2,000 needs both signatures.
legal: Any check exceeding $2,000 shall require the signatures of both Partners.

plain: Neither partner can take a loan in the business's name alone.
legal: Neither Partner shall incur any borrowing in the name of the Business without the consent of the other Partner.

plain: Partners will each take a monthly draw of $3,000.
legal: Each Partner shall be entitled to a monthly drawing of $3,000.

plain: The books will be kept by an outside accountant.
legal: The books of account shall be maintained by an independent accountant.

plain: Each partner can look at the books at any time.
legal: Each Partner shall have the right to inspect the books of account at any time.

plain: If one partner wants to leave, the other gets the first chance to buy their share.
legal: If a Partner wishes to withdraw, the remaining Partner shall have a right of first refusal to purchase the withdrawing Partner's interest.

plain: The share price will be set by an independent valuer.
legal: The purchase price of the interest shall be determined by an independent valuer.

plain: Partners can't run a competing business.
legal: No Partner shall engage in any business that competes with the Business.

plain: Each partner must work at least 40 hours a week in the business.
legal: Each Partner shall devote not less than forty (40) hours per week to the Business.

plain: New partners can join only if all current partners agree.
legal: A new partner may be admitted only with the unanimous consent of the existing Partners.

plain: The company will hold a board meeting every quarter.
legal: The Board shall meet on a quarterly basis.

plain: Shareholders get one vote per share.
legal: Each shareholder shall be entitled to one (1) vote per share.

plain: Shares can't be sold to outsiders without offering them to existing shareholders first.
legal: No shares shall be transferred to a third party unless first offered to the existing shareholders.

plain: If the company is sold, everyone must sell on the same terms.
legal: In the event of a sale of the Company, all shareholders shall be required to sell their shares on identical terms.

plain: Minority shareholders can join a sale on the same terms as the majority.
legal: Minority shareholders shall be entitled to participate in any sale on the same terms as the majority shareholders.

plain: Dividends will be paid only if the board approves.
legal: Dividends shall be paid only upon the approval of the Board.

plain: The investor gets a seat on the board.
legal: The Investor shall be entitled to appoint one (1) director to the Board.

plain: The investor's $500,000 buys 20% of the company.
legal: In consideration of an investment of $500,000, the Investor shall receive 20% of the issued share capital of the Company.

plain: The founders can't sell their shares for 2 years.
legal: The Founders shall not transfer any of their shares for a period of two (2) years.

plain: The company will send investors monthly financial updates.
legal: The Company shall provide the Investors with monthly financial reports.

plain: Each party pays its own costs for this deal.
legal: Each Party shall bear its own costs in connection with this transaction.

plain: The joint venture will last 5 years unless extended.
legal: The Joint Venture shall continue for a term of five (5) years unless extended.

plain: Each side will appoint 2 people to the management committee.
legal: Each Party shall appoint two (2) representatives to the Management Committee.

plain: If the committee can't agree, the CEOs will try to resolve it.
legal: Any deadlock in the Management Committee shall be referred to the chief executive officers of the Parties for resolution.

plain: The agency will introduce us to potential buyers.
legal: The Agent shall introduce the Principal to prospective purchasers.

plain: The agent gets 5% of any sale they arrange.
legal: The Agent shall receive a commission of 5% of the value of any sale arranged by the Agent.

plain: The agent can't make promises on our behalf.
legal: The Agent shall not make any representation or commitment on behalf of the Principal.

plain: This letter of intent isn't binding, except the confidentiality part.
legal: This Letter of Intent shall not be legally binding, save for the provisions relating to confidentiality.

plain: We'll negotiate exclusively with you for 60 days.
legal: The Seller shall negotiate exclusively with the Buyer for a period of sixty (60) days.

plain: The buyer can do due diligence during that time.
legal: The Buyer shall be entitled to conduct due diligence during the exclusivity period.

plain: The deal closes once all approvals have been obtained.
legal: Completion shall occur upon receipt of all required approvals.

plain: The seller will run the business normally until the deal closes.
legal: The Seller shall continue to operate the Business in the ordinary course until completion.

plain: The seller won't hire new senior staff before closing without our approval.
legal: Prior to completion, the Seller shall not appoint any senior employee without the Buyer's approval.

plain: Part of the price, $100,000, is held back for 12 months to cover claims.
legal: A portion of the purchase price amounting to $100,000 shall be retained for twelve (12) months as security for any claims.

plain: The sponsorship gives you naming rights for the stadium for 10 years.
legal: The Sponsorship grants the Sponsor the naming rights to the Stadium for a period of ten (10) years.

plain: The sponsor pays $2,000,000 a year.
legal: The Sponsor shall pay an annual fee of $2,000,000.

plain: The sponsor's logo will appear on all team shirts.
legal: The Sponsor's logo shall be displayed on all team shirts.

plain: The franchise fee is $45,000, paid upfront.
legal: The initial franchise fee of $45,000 shall be payable in advance.

plain: The franchisee pays 6% of monthly sales as royalties.
legal: The Franchisee shall pay royalties equal to 6% of monthly gross sales.

plain: The franchisee must follow the operations manual.
legal: The Franchisee shall comply with the Operations Manual.

plain: The franchisor will provide 2 weeks of initial training.
legal: The Franchisor shall provide initial training for a period of two (2) weeks.

plain: The franchisee can't open another restaurant within 5 km of this one.
legal: The Franchisee shall not open any other restaurant within 5 km of the Premises.

plain: The supplier will be our only provider of packaging for 3 years.
legal: The Supplier shall be the exclusive provider of packaging to the Company for a period of three (3) years.

plain: Both parties will review prices every 6 months.
legal: The Parties shall review the prices every six (6) months.

plain: Any changes to this agreement must be in writing and signed by both sides.
legal: Any amendment to this Agreement shall be made in writing and signed by both Parties.

plain: Neither party can transfer this agreement without the other's consent.
legal: Neither Party shall assign this Agreement without the prior consent of the other Party.

plain: Notices should be sent to the addresses at the top of this agreement.
legal: All notices shall be sent to the addresses set out at the head of this Agreement.

plain: Emails count as written notice.
legal: Notice given by email shall constitute written notice.

plain: This agreement can be signed in separate copies.
legal: This Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts.

plain: Electronic signatures are valid.
legal: Electronic signatures shall be valid and binding.

plain: Headings are just for convenience and don't affect the meaning.
legal: Headings are for convenience only and shall not affect the interpretation of this Agreement.

plain: Nothing here makes us partners or employees of each other.
legal: Nothing in this Agreement shall create a partnership or employment relationship between the Parties.

plain: The board can remove the CEO by majority vote.
legal: The Board may remove the Chief Executive Officer by a majority vote.

plain: Directors must declare any personal interest in a deal.
legal: Each director shall declare any personal interest in a proposed transaction.

plain: Directors with a conflict can't vote on that matter.
legal: A director having a conflict of interest shall not vote on the relevant matter.
